2. Safety notes
- Do not use the purifier in bathrooms or where relative humidity exceeds 80%.
- Keep at least 30 cm clearance on all sides and 1 m from heaters.
- Unplug before opening any cover. The UV-C lamp (Pro) switches off automatically when the front cover opens.
3. Setup (first use)
1. Unbox the purifier and remove ALL plastic packaging from the main filter (the filter ships sealed in a plastic
bag inside the unit).

1. Unbox the purifier and remove ALL plastic packaging from the main filter (the filter ships sealed in a plastic
bag inside the unit).
2. Place the purifier on a flat, hard floor at least 30 cm away from walls, curtains and furniture. Do not place it on
carpet with long pile.
3. Plug the power cable into a 100-240 V outlet. Avoid shared multi-plug extension cords.
4. Press and hold the Power button for 3 seconds. The ring light turns white and the unit starts in Auto mode.
5. Let the sensor calibrate for the first 10 minutes. During calibration the air-quality ring blinks blue; do not move
the unit.
6. (AQ-200 and AQ-200 Pro only) Install the AeroPure Home app, then press and hold Wi-Fi + Timer for 5
seconds until the Wi-Fi icon blinks, and follow the in-app pairing. Only 2.4 GHz networks are supported.

6. (AQ-200 and AQ-200 Pro only) Install the AeroPure Home app, then press and hold Wi-Fi + Timer for 5
seconds until the Wi-Fi icon blinks, and follow the in-app pairing. Only 2.4 GHz networks are supported.
7. Choose a mode: Auto (recommended), Sleep (lowest noise, display off), or manual fan speed 1-4 (Turbo =
speed 4).

6. Frequently asked questions
Q: Can I wash the main HEPA filter?
A: No. Only the pre-filter (PF-200) is washable. Washing the HEPA/carbon filter destroys it.
Q: Can I use the purifier in a bathroom?
A: No. Do not use the purifier where relative humidity is above 80% or where it can be splashed with water.
Q: Why is the air-quality ring red right after I turn it on?
A: During the first 10 minutes the sensor is calibrating. If the ring stays red for more than 1 hour in a closed
room, clean the PM2.5 sensor lens.
Q: Does the purifier remove viruses?

room, clean the PM2.5 sensor lens.
Q: Does the purifier remove viruses?
A: The H13 HEPA filter captures 99.95% of particles at 0.3 microns in lab tests. AeroPure makes no medical
claims.
Q: Does the AQ-200 support 5 GHz Wi-Fi?
A: No. Only 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi is supported on AQ-200 and AQ-200 Pro. The Lite has no Wi-Fi.
Q: How do I turn on child lock?
A: Hold the Lock (padlock) button for 3 seconds. Hold again for 3 seconds to unlock.
Q: How long does a filter last?
A: About 6 months (2,160 h) in normal use, or about 4 months with pets, smoking or heavy cooking. The filter
indicator turns red at end of life.
Q: Is the filter the same for all models?
A: No. AQ-200 Lite and AQ-200 use FL-200H. AQ-200 Pro uses the larger FL-200P.
Q: What does the warranty cover?
A: Manufacturing defects for 2 years (Lite, AQ-200) or 3 years (Pro). Filters, pre-filters and UV-C lamps are
consumables and are not covered.
